title: SLOPE 4 of 4 and INTERCEPT 4 of 4: two per-surface figures, four rows each
upstream_status_verbatim: SLOPE/INTERCEPT confirmed already bit-exact (share the kernel, `4/4` each).
status_plain: SLOPE and INTERCEPT were each scored on their own four-row corpus and each matched Excel on all four. The catalogue's wording is decisive about the scope - "4/4 each" - and the corpora agree: smart-fuzzer/work/w109/G3-03-answers-slope.json declares "function": "SLOPE" with four witnesses and G3-03-answers-intercept.json declares "function": "INTERCEPT" with four. These are per-surface figures, not a slice of any group. No repair happened: the source says the existing paired_stats_common implementations already ARE the identified kernel, so the shipping code was scored and needed no edit. Four rows is four rows. The build (20131) is stated once for the whole sweep and is not restated on the line, and the source does not say whether the four rows were held out.
